subject.title: feat: expose ClawHub catalog feed lanes

question: Should ClawHub expose unauthenticated root catalog feed lanes with reviewed and attestation semantics, and must those lanes be served from stored `catalogFeedPublications` before merge?
rationale: This sets a new public API and trust contract for feed consumers, and the safe serving model is a maintainer product and operations decision rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Use Stored Root Feed Snapshots
options.body: Require the new root lanes to publish through `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cache-protected snapshot path before exposing public routes.

options.title: Approve Dynamic Root Feeds
options.body: Accept the live query model, reviewed-lane semantics, attestation wording, and feed ids as the intentional public contract.

options.title: Pause The Feed Stack
options.body: Keep the draft paused until the cross-repository feed RFC and OpenClaw consumer stack settle enough to anchor ClawHub producer behavior.

recommendation.title: Use Stored Root Feed Snapshots
recommendation.body: Require the new root lanes to publish through `catalogFeedPublications` or an equivalent cache-protected snapshot path before exposing public routes.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest main history makes this person the clearest owner for the hosted feed contract and route boundary.
